# Venue record — NeurIPS 2026 main track

Owner: `venue-repo`. Sources: the world's venue library (`ht-role venue neurips`, retrieved there 2026-11-14) which cites the venue's own pages; each line below names its source. What the library could not establish is listed under "Not established". Re-check before any real submission: NeurIPS 2027 pages returned 404 on 2026-11-14, and the 2026 deadlines (May 2026) have passed.

## 1. Which venue and why (answer to `venue-repo`#2)
The objective lets the study choose ICML, ICLR or NeurIPS and asks for "the venue's checklist, e.g. NeurIPS's paper checklist". Choice: **NeurIPS 2026, Main Track**.

| | NeurIPS 2026 | ICML 2027 | ICLR 2027 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Newest edition with published kit | yes (2026) | yes (2027) | yes (2027) |
| Main text | 9 pages, one column, 5.5 in text width | 8 pages, two columns, 6.75 in | 9 pages, one column, 5.5 in |
| Checklist | **mandatory, 16 items, desk-reject if missing** | none (impact statement + AI-use statement) | none (AI-use statement; reproducibility statement optional) |
| Review scales | Quality, Clarity, Significance, Originality (1–4), overall 1–6, Limitations item | Soundness, Presentation, Significance, Originality (1–4), overall 1–6 | scales not established |

Reasons: the checklist the objective names exists only at NeurIPS and its items (statistical significance, compute resources, code/data access, limitations, licences) match the objective's review criteria (uncertainty, scope of conclusions, limits, reproduction); the study is an empirical-evaluation paper and NeurIPS reviewers score Quality/Clarity/Significance/Originality with a separate Limitations item; one column at 9 pages gives more room than ICML's 8 two-column pages. This is a judgement, not a venue requirement: the other two would also be admissible.

## 2. Hard requirements (all from `ht-role venue neurips`; its page cites the source of each)
**Length.** 9 content pages including all figures and tables (MainTrackHandbook; `neurips_2026.tex` §1.1). Not counted: references, technical appendices, the paper checklist (acknowledgments are hidden in anonymous mode and camera-ready only). No limit on references/appendix/checklist. Exceeding the limit: "will not be reviewed". Camera-ready: +1 page (not our case).
**Template.** `neurips_2026.sty` + `neurips_2026.tex` + `checklist.tex`; `ht-role venue neurips --template DIR` copies them. US Letter, single column, 5.5 × 9 in text block, Times 10 pt on 11 pt leading; no changes to margins, font size or vertical spacing ("may be grounds for desk rejection"); no `fullpage`/`geometry`.
**Type sizes floor** (set by the style): `\footnotesize` ≥ 8 pt, `\scriptsize` ≥ 7 pt, `\tiny` ≥ 6 pt; references may be `\small` (9 pt). Text in figures should be ≥ 7 pt at printed size (our recommendation from the 7 pt `\scriptsize` floor; the venue states no rule for figure text). Only Type 1 / embedded TrueType fonts in the PDF (no Type 3): matplotlib needs `pdf.fonttype = 42`.
**Widths.** Text width 5.5 in. A figure or table wider than 5.5 in sticks into the margin and risks the "do not change the text rectangle" rule; keep ≤ 5.5 in (`\linewidth`). Half-width figures: ≤ 2.7 in each side by side. (Widths are derived from the 5.5 in block.)
**Mode.** Default (neither `final` nor `preprint`) = anonymous submission: author block "Anonymous Author(s)", line numbers, footer "Submitted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Do not distribute." Use `final` only for camera-ready. Do not refer to line numbers.
